title: Smiling Mother and Daughter by New Home Porch, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
This is our new? abode - part of the front entrance

499 K
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot featuring a smiling woman and a young girl standing by the large white classical columns of a home's front entrance and upper balcony. The wood-sided house has large framed windows and deep shadows cast by harsh daylight. The handwritten note on the back humorously introduces the location as their 'new? abode'.
